dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave curvature along the trailing edge from the apex to the mid-section, transitioning into an irregular, jagged profile at the posterior base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Small-radius rounded apex forming an obtuse morphological transition.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear ascent at approximately a 50-degree angle relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Proportional ratio of approximately 1.3:1 base width to vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple irregular notches and deep serrations along the lower half of the trailing edge; numerous white punctate markings distributed across the lateral fin surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive jagged erosion pattern at the posterior insertion point where the fin meets the dorsal peduncle.
